acceptanceCriteria: 状态快照和索引函数在现有 status_projection 模块中实现，root 对外 re-export 保持调用方兼容。
当前 snapshot、repository identity、governance/readiness/status digest 和 unknown/failure semantics unchanged.
repository tests and affected CLI/MCP compile/tests pass; no protocol or release behavior.
change is maintenance boundary only, no runtime acceleration claim.
goal: 把 work_item_status_snapshot_with_runtime、work_item_status_index_with_runtime 及其 request-scoped aggregation 从 lib.rs 迁入现有 status_projection.rs；保留 root re-export、私有 helper 访问和 JSON/identity 语义，不宣称性能收益。
intent: 在 cockpit-repository 现有 crate 内将 Work Item 状态读模型归入 status_projection 模块，保持公开接口与治理事实稳定。
outOfScope: 不拆新 crate；不改 public signatures/serialization/protocol/CLI/MCP/release/compatibility；不作性能收益声明。
